wind.note: High-wind recording, high-passed at 130 Hz to take out a low hum; mostly low rush, no whistles.

carve.note: Steady snow hiss from a real recording of skiing down a groomed piste (wind and ski noise together).

skid.note: Brighter, louder stretch of a real alpine ski POV recording, high-passed at 500 Hz; closest real match to a sideways scrape.

powder.note: Soft, muffled stretch of the same real ski recording, low-passed at 2.5 kHz; no true deep-powder recording was found.

pop.note: Stand-in: a single crisp snow crunch from a snow footstep recording.

land.note: Body falling onto hard snow (thump with crunch).

land_soft.note: A softer fall onto snow from the same recording.

crash.note: Snow collapse and fall: thumps and snow scattering.

rail_hit.note: Single metal clang from a metal hit recording.

rail_grind.note: Real recording of a skateboard sliding on a metal rail (the closest found to skis on a rail).

box_hit.note: Plastic impact/drop from a plastic impact recording.

box_slide.note: Real recording of sliding on bumpy plastic.

schat.note: Stand-in: a single snow crunch grain, high-passed at 2 kHz to make a short sharp flick.

lift_hum.note: Real recording of a ski lift motor (remontee mecanique).

lift_clack.note: Sheave clacks of a chairlift passing a tower.

ambience.note: Distant wind in trees on a windy winter day; steady, no voices.
